includePatterns.description:
Array of regexes to filter test cases to only those that match one or more of the patterns.
    In JUnit tests, the filter is applied to the method name.
    In Jasmine tests, the filter is applied to the describe and its block descriptions.
    In Pytest tests, we use the -k command line option to specify an expression which implements a substring
    match test on the full name of the test. The expression we provide to -k option is the "or" of all the
    strings inside the field includePatterns. An entry of the field includePatterns of spec argument can not be a
    python keyword though it can contain a python expression using "and", "or", "not" and parentheses like "not send_http".
    The PyTest does not support regex only substring matching.
    For more details see [Using -k expr to select tests based on their name](https://docs.pytest.org/en/latest/example/markers.html#using-k-expr-to-select-tests-based-on-their-name).

inSingleSession.description: True if test suites are to run in a single session. There is only one test context initiation and teardown.

remoteServerUrl.description: Url for remote {@link Env} to run tests against with.

seedBaselineUiCodeCoverageData.description: Flag to determine whether to run the custom test used to generate the baseline UI code coverage data.

serverLogDir.description:
If running multiple tests in the same JVM, we should extract server logs per-test to make it easier to associate
them with the results. If this field is specified, server logs files will be written to it split out by test using
{@link Logger#startForwarding}.

Note that this does not affect the normal logging level or location, it creates a _separate_ per-test export of
the server log.

excludeNetworkRequests.description:
If specified, remove {@TestSuiteResult#networkRequests} from the final {@TestSuiteResult} instance.
Network requests are unbounded and can vary depending on the test. Consumers relying on serialization performance
should enable this to significantly reduce the size of {@TestSuiteResult} instance.

tests.description: If specified, only run the tests included in the list within the scope of the TestRunner.
